name: flarebase
description: FlareBase — Fast, secure, multi-tenant Backend-as-a-Service built for indie hackers & teams

scripts.build:client: cd packages/client && npx tsup src/index.ts --format cjs,esm,iife --dts --global-name FlareBase --clean && cp dist/index.global.js ../../public/flarebase.js
scripts.build:react: cd packages/react && npx tsup src/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --clean --external react
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:react && tsc --project tsconfig.json
